bots.name: Grusel-Bot
bots.text: Horror-Kurzfilm mit Erzähler: Mumien, Geister, verlassene Orte.
bots.beispiel: a creepy bandaged mummy wakes up in an ancient tomb and chases an explorer
ideen: a haunted lighthouse keeper's lantern turns on by itself every midnight and lures sailors to a ghost ship
a scarecrow walks through a foggy cornfield at night hunting crows that stole its button eyes
an abandoned carnival ride starts spinning by itself in the rain and a shadow waves from the top

bots.name: Cartoon-Bot
bots.beispiel: a tiny fox finds a fallen star and brings it back to the sky
ideen: a tiny robot gardener tries to grow the biggest pumpkin in town and it floats away like a balloon
a shy cloud learns to make rainbows to cheer up a gloomy village
a penguin chef opens an ice-cream truck in the desert

bots.name: Anime-Kampf-Bot
bots.text: Anime-Kampfszene mit Effekten, Impact-Frames und schnellen Schnitten.
bots.beispiel: two rival sword masters clash on a burning bridge
ideen: a lightning-fast fox spirit duels a giant stone golem in a bamboo forest
two rival sky pirates clash on top of a flying airship during a thunderstorm
a young mage with a fire whip battles a frost dragon on a frozen lake

bots.name: Kino-Bot
bots.text: Realistischer Kurzfilm im Blockbuster-Look mit Erzähler.
bots.beispiel: a lone astronaut discovers a glowing forest on a frozen moon
ideen: a deep-sea diver discovers a glowing city at the bottom of the ocean
a lone rider races a sandstorm across a red desert toward a hidden oasis
an astronaut repairs a satellite while a meteor shower lights up the earth below

bots.name: Welten-Bot
bots.text: Epische Naturgewalten und Weltall, durchgehende Kamerafahrt ohne Menschen.
bots.beispiel: a colossal ringed planet rising over a glowing alien ocean
ideen: a volcano erupts under the northern lights while lava meets the sea
a gigantic waterfall pours off the edge of a floating island into the clouds
a supercell storm forms over endless golden wheat fields at sunset
